title: WaterColor "Royal Retreat" 21 Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands- Quiet location in WaterColor's Forest District- Furnished porch- Gas grill - Office space- 4 adult bikes- Parking for 5 vehicles- Trolley service - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: "Royal Retreat" is a beautiful home perfectly tucked away in the quiet and much-desired WaterColor Camp District. This home offers 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and wonderful accommodations for 10 guests. Screened porches, bright interiors, and elegant coastal decor make this peaceful home a perfect location for your next 30A getaway!The spacious main floor area joins the living room, dining room, and kitchen. In the kitchen, granite countertops and high-end stainless steel appliances make a great place to prepare family meals. The beautiful wood dining table can accommodate up to 8 guests. A comfortable sectional sofa, plush armchairs, and a large flat-screen television invite guests to relax in the living room, accentuated by high ceilings and abundant natural light.The first floor offers two beautiful bedrooms. The first is a queen bed guest room featuring a shared bathroom with a shower and separate soaking tub. The primary suite presents a luxurious king bed and a private en suite bathroom with a shower, a dual-sink vanity, and a separate soaking tub. On the second floor is a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. This setup is perfect for young guests in your group!For guests seeking ultra-private accommodations, the carriage house offers the perfect setup. This space features a spacious living area with a large mounted 70-inch flat-screen television, a queen sleeper sofa, 4 armchairs, and a comfortable king Murphy bed. The carriage house also offers a private bathroom with a glass-front shower. The kitchenette features a bistro dining table, a mini-refrigerator, a microwave, and a sink.Two screened porches offer guests the perfect place to enjoy this home's beautiful surroundings and the tranquility of a stay in the Camp District. This home is equipped with 4 custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes, which provide a picturesque ride to the sugar-white sand beach and through our scenic 30A coastal towns.Get the convenient location and privacy that WaterColor is known for when you plan your next getaway at "Royal Retreat." Book your stay today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10)FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo and Standalone Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Murphy Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Additional Sleeping: Queen Sleeper Sofa*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-serve basis.
